result.topic_en: The page completes an induction step (from n to n-1) in the proof of the arithmetic-geometric mean inequality, sketches a circuit for switching a current on and off independently from two or more places, and poses sphere-packing and circle-packing questions together with a related polygon minimization problem.

$[-\frac{n}{n-1}-]\left(\frac{a_1+\dots+a_{n-1}}{n-1}\right)^{n-1} \geqq a_1\dots a_{n-1}$ q.e.d.
